notes: v1.0.15 Render speed optimizations (blur_fit low-res, 30fps cut, merged encode) + batch lookahead + remove 45-min limit
Perf: blur_fit background rendered at 540x960 then scaled up (70% faster blur pass)
Perf: segments cut at 30fps when final output is 30fps (50% fewer frames to encode)
Perf: title, subtitle, speed-up merged into single FFmpeg pass (saves 2-3 full H.264 encodes)
Perf: batch mode processes next Gemini while current video renders (lookahead-1 overlap)
Perf: source-cache copies use hard-links when filesystem allows
Fix: render queue race condition at worker exit
Fix: Gemini automation pipeline lock prevents concurrent Chrome profile access
Fix: shorter public error message for Gemini short responses
